description:
**New:** support for **rif is fun golden platinum** (com.andrewshu.android.redditdonation) — Inline comment images + the ReVanced settings screen. (Platinum has no ads, so Disable ads stays free-only.)

**New patch — Fix imgur albums:** imgur album posts and links no longer crash (or bounce back a page) and load reliably. Fixes a bug in the official ReVanced rif patch's imgur API code and sends rif's imgur client ID with album requests. Select it alongside the official Change OAuth client ID patch.

**Inline comment images**
- Multi-image imgur albums show an n/x badge, plus optional left/right navigation: tap the left/right third to cycle images, the middle to open the album (new setting: Inline album navigation).
- Tapping an image under a [text](url) link now opens it.
- Album links in comments open in rif's own album viewer again.
- Fixed images on a new line after text clipping the line above.
- More robust GIF animation.

**Disable ads:** also removes ads in the album viewer.

**Under the hood:** the extension no longer bundles an unused copy of the Kotlin library (bundle ~690 KB → ~70 KB); build fixes for fresh clones.
